name: wordpress-operations
summary: Canonical discipline for mutable WordPress state, MCP/REST/WP-CLI/browser operations, environment targeting, before-state capture, rollback, and rendered verification.
blocking_rules: Do not mutate WordPress state until the exact client, site, environment, adapter, approval class, and target object are identified.
Do not treat MCP, REST, WP-CLI, browser, or helper availability as proof of the correct target; run a safe read-only identity check first.
Do not change production administrative, destructive, broad configuration, plugin/theme lifecycle, users/roles, database, migration, or restore state without explicit approval and rollback.
Do not hide a missing code capability with brittle editor markup, direct database hacks, or duplicated content; route code gaps to Developer.
Do not claim completion from a mutation response alone; read back stored state and verify rendered or functional behavior when user-visible.
Do not store or expose secrets in .agents, harness, root docs, reports, prompts, or manifests.
